jobs.occupation: Technical Assistant / Junior Technician - 2 Shifts - Bruges
jobs.description:
Have you completed a technical education, but do you not yet have the years of experience many vacancies ask for?

Then we would still like to hear from you!

For an automated production environment in Bruges, we are looking for a Technical Assistant / Junior Technician who wants to further develop within industrial maintenance.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What we do expect is a solid techncial foundation, an interest in machinery and, above all, the motivation to learn.

What will you do?

• Perform preventive maintenance

• Carry out basic technical interventions

• Analyse breakdowns and help solve them

• Check electrical and mechanical components

• Work with motors, sensors and production installations

• Replace or repair technical parts

• Perform small technical repairs and maintenance tasks

• Provide technical support for new machines and workstations

• Identify abnormalities and report them correctly

• Contribute ideas for improvements to machines and installations

During your first months, you will receive intensive guidance from an experienced technician.

• You have completed a full technical education

• For example in electricity, electromechanics, industrial technology or a similiar field

• Good basic knowledge of electricity and/or mechanics

• Willing to work in a 2-shift System

• You speak very good English and are willing to learn Dutch.

jobs.occupation: Lead Contract Engineer Nuclear Pressure Equipment (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X) in the Nuclear Pressure Equipment Team, you will join a dynamic team that works every day for our customers and, in doing so, helps create a safer and more efficient society. Vinçotte is active with various types of customers. We have developed our expertise and organization in both public and residential buildings, and we are highly entrepreneurial in the energy sector, including nuclear activities. In addition, we are highly innovative for customers in the (petro)chemical and pharmaceutical sectors, production environments, and the transport and logistics sector. With unparalleled expertise and boundless passion, we are committed to a safer society. With more than 60,000 satisfied customers, we demonstrate that the combination of our expertise, guidance, and technology makes all the difference. Vinçotte is part of Kiwa, which is itself a member of the SHV Family of Companies, and continues its commitment to innovation to deliver ever greater safety and efficiency.
 

As a 
Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers. You build a relationship of trust with the customer and provide tailored advice for the assessment of the construction/design of nuclear pressure equipment according to various construction codes and standards. You maintain regular contact with your customers and also carry out inspections yourself. You are responsible for following up projects from A to Z, from quotation and design through to actual execution and invoicing. In addition, you are also the point of contact for the inspectors on site.
 

You can always rely on your colleagues: driven experts who are happy to help you further.
 

Vinçotte also supports you in deepening and broadening your expertise. We start this on your very first day, as you will first receive thorough training and an internship before working independently.

 

• Degree: You have a Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences – Electromechanics. A Welding Engineer degree is a strong asset. 

• Experience: You preferably have around five years of experience in the maintenance/inspection of pressure equipment. 

• Skills: 
 

• You are eager to learn and keep up to date with trends and developments in your field. 

• You have a sense of quality and an eye for detail. 

• You show initiative and enjoy customer contact. 

• You work independently and in a disciplined manner. 

• You speak fluent Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of English (both written and spoken). 

• You are communicative and entrepreneurial, with a sense of initiative and organization.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
A growing company that provides bespoke packaging and storage services for frozen and chilled food products for European customers. By 2027, the company aims to have over 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging orders. You'll work in a respectful environment where teamwork and job satisfaction are key.

For a client in the Roeselare region, within the food sector, Let's Work is looking for an experienced forklift operator for day shifts.

Your main responsibilities will include the safe handling and storage of goods, operating the forklift to a height of up to 8 metres and ensuring a smooth flow of goods to the packaging department. On top of that, you can count on a starting wage of €15.23 per hour, meal vouchers worth €7 per day and attractive working hours from 8.00 am to 4.30 pm.

Are you looking for a great logistics job on the day shift? Be sure to read on!

What will you be handling as a forklift operator?

You'll spend most of your day (±90%) operating the forklift

 
• 
You'll be placing octabins and pallets at heights of up to 8 metres in the warehouse

You communicate fluently in English to work effectively with colleagues

Working in a cold environment (deep-freeze), using a heated forklift truck, is in line with your expectations

 
• 
Working accurately and respecting safety are second nature to you

During your journey at Tein Technology, you'll develop expertise in:

POSITION’S REQUIREMENTS  Education, Knowledge & Experience

What Makes You a Great Fit

Would you like to join an international company on a human scale in Brussels and gain valuable professional experience? We are looking for a versatile Travel & Customer Care Assistant to support the DiscoverEU team in delivering smooth travel coordination and high-quality participant support. Key Responsibilities Travel & Customer Care
 
 
 
• Respond promptly to participant enquiries via email and chat, ensuring agreed service levels are met 
 
• Coordinate travel logistics, including booking support, document verification, and expense/invoice tracking 
 
• Identify and escalate complex cases to the appropriate team members when required 
 
• Manage special travel situations (e.g. accessibility needs, lost tickets, rebookings) and maintain accurate records 
 
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures, data protection rules, and financial guidelines 
 
• Support administrative tasks and team coordination as needed 
 
• Troubleshoot participant documentation issues and follow escalation processes 
 

 Admin, IT & Tools
 
 
 
• Use internal platforms and helpdesk tools to efficiently assist participants 
 
• Work with databases, IT systems, and standard office tools 
 
• Ensure all data handling complies with GDPR and internal IT security protocols 
 
• Promote sustainability principles as part of EMAS commitments 

 
 
•   
 
• Available between June and August (with extension until September–October for German and/or Polish speakers) 
 
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken) 
 
• Good written skills in German, Dutch, and/or Polish (German and Polish are strong assets) 
 
• Strong customer service mindset and professional communication skills 
 
• Well-organised, able to manage priorities and meet deadlines 
 
• Detail-oriented, with a focus on quality, accuracy, and consistency 
 
•

The offer

• You run steering committees and governance forums, and keep actions, risks, decisions and escalations firmly on track.
• Your management presentations and decision proposals shape where the program goes next.
• KPIs, forecasts and portfolio reporting come together with you, giving management one clear and reliable view of performance, trends and risks.
• Deep-dive analyses of processes, tools and ways of working, especially at Fiberklaar, reveal where things can be simpler, smarter and more automated.
• Turning those insights into reality is where you make the difference: you define better processes, tooling improvements and future operating models, and you help bring them to life.
• As the trusted link between operations and management, you align partners around shared goals and help a fast-growing fibre organisation become more efficient, scalable and industrialised.

Desired profile

• Experience in program management and/or business transformation
• A proven track record in process analysis and process improvement
• Experience with KPI reporting, performance tracking and governance
• Experience in telecom, network deployment, construction or fibre rollout is an asset
💡 Your skills

• You quickly find your way in complex operational environments and turn findings into concrete improvements.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills help you get to the root of issues.
• You build trust with stakeholders at every level and communicate with ease.
• You work comfortably in Dutch, French and English.
🌟 Who are you?

• A structured organiser with a hands-on, results-oriented mindset
• Someone who brings order and keeps moving things forward
• Passionate about operational excellence, digitalisation and automation

The offer

• Join one of Belgium’s largest fibre rollouts as the technical and operational reference point for MDU (multi-dwelling unit) files within the Build & Deployment team.
• Each MDU file assigned to you is your responsibility: you follow its technical progress through every deployment step, including Delay orders, preventive tickets and POB (Proof of Build) deliveries.
• Reliable information is your starting point: you check the consistency of plans and technical data and challenge them when they don’t match reality.
• Anomalies, risks and blockers don’t stay hidden for long: you analyse their root causes, define resolution actions and escalate what needs a decision or extra expertise.
• SSV and TSA teams can count on your technical support, from preparing field interventions to analysing feedback and following corrective actions through to closure.
• In the field and behind the screen, you connect what happens on site with engineering, design and the Build team, and you feed verified field data to the Data Analyst Build.
• Build management relies on your clear reporting on file status, key risks and open actions, which gives them the visibility they need to de-risk MDU activities.

Desired profile

• A technical background that lets you understand and analyse issues in the field
• The following are an asset:
• experience in telecommunications, FTTH, infrastructure deployment or a similar environment
• knowledge of the FTTH and MDU environment
• knowledge of SSV and TSA activities
💡 Your skills

• You read and interpret technical plans and documents with ease.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills help you get to the root of an issue, and you are comfortable working with data.
• You work fluently with office and reporting tools.
• You communicate clearly with both technical and operational stakeholders.
• You speak French fluently and have a professional level of English. 
🌟 Who are you?

• Just as comfortable with data and documentation as you are with field teams
• Rigorous, organised and autonomous in your follow-up
• Someone who takes ownership of an issue, from its identification through to its resolution or escalation

Robert Half is currently looking for an Office & Management Assistant (m/f/x).

The company is located in Brussels and this is a full-time position within an architecture and consulting environment.

 

You will join a growing, close-knit organisation of approximately 25 independent professionals, mainly architects. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the organisation.

 

This is not a traditional secretarial position. The company is looking for a versatile, hands-on and proactive individual who can take ownership of the operational and administrative management of the office, ranging from financial administration and project follow-up to coordinating external service providers.

 

You will work closely with management, gradually taking over a number of operational and administrative responsibilities. As the organisation continues to grow, you will have the opportunity to expand your responsibilities and develop towards a fully-fledged Office Manager position.

 

The responsibilities of this position as Office & Management Assistant are:

• You ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the office and oversee the general management of its facilities and services.
• You coordinate external service providers, including cleaning services, suppliers and delivery companies.
• You handle the administrative follow-up of clients, suppliers and various operational requests.
• You manage invoicing, including through Peppol and other digital platforms, and ensure the follow-up of outstanding customer and supplier invoices (approximately 300 invoices per year).
• You monitor payments, expense claims and professional expenses.
• You maintain contact with the external accounting firm and provide support with accounting and tax-related processes.
• You contribute to the financial and budgetary follow-up of approximately 50 to 60 projects running simultaneously.
• You monitor registered working hours and hourly rates to ensure accurate project invoicing.
• You prepare Excel reports, financial overviews and various management dashboards.
• You manage and update administrative information relating to projects and independent professionals.
• You actively identify opportunities to optimise internal processes through IT tools, management software and the automation of administrative tasks.
• You contribute to structuring and improving internal administrative procedures as the organisation continues to grow.
• You provide direct operational and organisational support to management.

The required qualifications for this position as Office & Management Assistant are:

• You have a first relevant experience in an administrative position, Office Management or Management Assistance. Motivated recent graduates are also encouraged to apply.
• You hold a degree in Business Management, IT, Software, Administration or an equivalent field.
• You have an excellent command of Dutch, French and English, both spoken and written. English is the main working language within the office.
• You have a strong affinity with figures, accounting, invoicing and financial processes.
• You have a good knowledge of Excel and are comfortable working with IT tools and management software.
• You are particularly interested in new technologies, digitalisation and process optimisation.
• You are well organised, accurate and able to manage several projects and priorities simultaneously.
• You are proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented, with a strong sense of initiative.
• You enjoy working independently while being a genuine team player.
• You feel comfortable in a small, dynamic working environment where you can take ownership and have a direct impact on the organisation.

About Us: Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

Job Description & Key ResponsibilitiesAs a OPEX engineer you will drive the continuous improvement culture within the production facility. In this role you will look beyond the surface, diving deep into the process to eliminate waste and scale manufacturing efficiency to the next level.
 

We’re looking for an energetic and enthusiastic personality with excellent communication skills, capable of inspiring and engaging teams to bring meaningful change and challenge the status quo, while respecting strict quality and safety.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 

• Process Optimization: you are responsible for identifying, implementing, and ensuring process improvements to increase efficiency, quality, and safety. 

• Follow-up on KPI’s; apply value stream mapping and execute Gemba walks. 

• Based on data driven analysis, you identify hidden opportunities and propose improvements. 

• Lead independently cross functional improvement projects with minimal supervision. 

• Standardization & training: write, revise, and standardize Standard Operating Procedures to embed new best practices firmly into daily operations; deliver training modules to build a site-wide OPEX mindset. Responsible for keeping training matrix up-to-date and organizing training accordingly, in collaboration with the production team lead. 

• Identify root causes of technical anomalies/malfunctions or inefficiencies. 

• Provide support with day-to-day technical problems; act as a point of contact for problem solving. 

• Support implementation of new equipment, systems or workflows. 

The role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, preventive way of thinking, a high degree of independence, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team. 
 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• A master’s degree in engineering/biotech with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a continuous Improvement or OPEX role within a manufacturing environment; 

• Proven track record of applying operational excellence techniques as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) in a production setting. 

• Analytical and data-driven, out-of-the-box thinking, solution-oriented mindset, and a hands-on approach. 

• Experience in biochemical process know-how and change-management is a plus. 

• A structured way of working, with an eye of detail, excellent communicator able to engage people, with a drive for continuous improvement. 

• Fluency in English, both verbal and written; fluency in Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Strategic Projects Lead - Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
About UsZymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

The RoleAs Strategic Projects Lead your core role will be to take ownership of projects that matter, from first idea to finished result. The job is mostly project-based. One project might be a market study for a new crop or region, the next might be designing the layout of our new offices or setting up our company OKRs. 
You will often get a question with little more than a goal attached. We trust you to figure out the rest: to structure the problem yourself and to deliver work of a high standard.
 

What You'll DoYour main focus is on strategic and operational projects. You will:
 
 

• Take full ownership of company-wide projects, from scoping and planning to execution and follow-up. 

• Conduct market research and analyses, for example on new markets, crops, competitors or customer 

• segments, and translate findings into clear recommendations. 

• Set up and follow up on our company OKRs together with management and team leads. 

• Handle confidential information, such as financial, strategic and personnel matters, with discretion.  

As Zymofix grows, new projects will land on your desk.

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You hold a master's degree in Bioscience Engineering (bio-ingenieur). 

• You are mature and discreet, and you know how to handle confidential information. 

• You set a high standard for the work you deliver: well thought out, structured and well presented. 

• You need few instructions to deliver a strong result. You structure a problem yourself, ask the right questions and take it from there. 

• You enjoy project work and are comfortable juggling several projects at once. 

• You have strong analytical skills and can turn research and data into clear, actionable conclusions. 

• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, both spoken and written. 

• A first work experience, for example in consulting or a startup environment, is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Management Assistant - International FMCG Company in Brussels
jobs.description:
As a Management Assistant, you will provide comprehensive administrative and organisational support to the management team. You will play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of daily operations, coordinating schedules, preparing meetings, and acting as a reliable point of contact across different departments.

Client Details

Our client is a leading international FMCG company based in Brussels, known for its portfolio of well-established consumer brands and collaborative working environment.

Description

As a Management Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage calendars, meetings and appointments to support smooth daily planning.
• Prepare documents, presentations and correspondence with care and accuracy.
• Coordinate meeting logistics, including room bookings and required materials.
• Maintain organised digital and paper files so information is easy to find.
• Handle incoming calls, emails and post, ensuring timely follow-up where needed.
• Arrange business travel and keep related schedules and documents up to date.
• Support administrative tasks for the Secretarial & Business Support department.
• Provide practical day-to-day assistance that helps colleagues work efficiently.

• You are perfectly bilingual in French and English, Dutch is a plus.
• You have a first experience in administration, office management, or executive support.
• You are comfortable managing calendars, meetings, and travel arrangements.
• You have excellent attention to detail and can maintain accurate records, files, and schedules.
• You possess strong organisational skills and can effectively manage multiple priorities.
• You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Good skills in MS Office.

In this role, you ensure that the packaging department operates smoothly from start to finish.

• Prepare and organize the daily packaging activities.
• Guide employees and distribute tasks across the team.
• Keep a close eye on product quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
• Follow up on packaging orders and coordinate priorities.
• Act quickly when technical or operational issues occur.
• Look for practical ways to improve efficiency on the production floor.
• Maintain clear communication with production planning and finished goods storage.
• Keep the Production Manager informed about progress and possible challenges.
• Help introduce and optimize the use of MES and ERP systems within the department.

• A first experience in production is preferred; experience in the food industry is a strong advantage.
• You are confident when guiding colleagues and making decisions on the work floor.
• A practical mindset and a flexible attitude come naturally to you.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality and detail.
• Good English communication skills are required.
• You are comfortable using computer systems and willing to learn new software.
• Working in two shifts fits your availability.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

As an Assembly Worker, you will:

 
• 
Assemble both large and small components based on assembly drawings

 
• 
Ensure the quality of your work by performing self-checks throughout the assembly process

 
• 
You have experience as an assembly worker

 
• 
You have the technical understanding needed to interpret plans and perform measurements

 
• 
You quickly pick up new assembly processes and working methods

 
• 
Knowledge of an ERP system is a plus

 
• 
You work accurately and keep your workplace orderly and clean

 
• 
Are you fluent in English and do you have a basic knowledge of Dutch? Great! That will ensure internal communication runs smoothly

 
•

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
A high-quality food company that delivers fresh products daily to hospitality clients and large-scale kitchens. The 300 employees work together day after day to make this possible. This market leader not only takes care of its customers, but also of its employees. Quality always comes first, which is why regular training is provided.

What does your working day look like as a Frozen Warehouse Worker?

 
• 
Restocking the frozen storage areas: you place incoming goods in the correct locations according to the warehouse layout

 
• 
You work with a handheld scanner that registers all movements

 
• 
You pick the correct goods and prepare them for transport, based on customer orders

 
•

•

• 
Experience in logistics or as a warehouse worker is a plus

 
• 
You pay close attention to quality

 
• 
You communicate good in Dutch or English to correctly follow up on order forms

jobs.occupation: Hays - ERP Consultant / Future ICT Manager
jobs.description:
As an IT ERP Consultant, your primary focus will be the ERP environment, which forms the core of the role. You will work closely with business stakeholders, end users, and external partners to analyze needs and implement sustainable solutions.

Your responsibilities include:

• Analyzing business requirements and translating them into IT solutions

• Performing both functional and technical analyses

• Acting as the link between business departments and IT

• Supporting and coordinating ERP-related projects

• Working within the Infor LN ERP environment

• Collaborating with external consultants and suppliers

• Contributing to process optimization and digitalization initiatives

Over time, the role will expand towards broader IT leadership responsibilities, including stakeholder management, supplier coordination, budget follow-up, contract management, continuity planning, and contributing to the company's IT strategy.
What you'll get in return
